title: Being unramified, respectively G-unramified, is fpqc local on the base
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts fpqc locality on the base for 'unramified' and for 'G-unramified' (statement lines 6403-6409). The proof uses the characterisation of an unramified morphism as one locally of finite type whose diagonal is an open immersion (and of a G-unramified morphism with local finite presentation in place of local finite type), records that each of those ingredient properties is already known to be fpqc local on the base, and concludes formally (proof lines 6411-6422). The level is H2: the decomposition of the property into two already-descending ingredients is displayed and each ingredient is matched to its earlier lemma.
